calculation.formation_v2: single-phase equilibrium at the phase's low-T composition, 298.15 K; dfS = S - sum x_i S_i(SER); SER entropies from unary equilibria at 298.15 K
calculation.liquid_mixing: calculate HM/GM of LIQUID minus linear pure-liquid reference

mixing_table.partials: H_i - H_i(pure liquid) from central differences of the integral HM_MIX (h = 1e-4)
mixing_table.reference: pure liquid A and B at T

v2.grid: same composition-set-aware grid as the field map
v2.stability_limits: grid limit snapped to an invariant/congruent/melting T within one grid step, otherwise bisection to 0.01 K at a fixed composition

sentences.text: This synthetic document describes the Mg–Sn binary system as calculated with pycalphad from the SGTE dataset MgSn-04Fri.tdb; every figure, table and stated value is generated, and the exact values are kept in a separate truth key.
The highest invariant reaction, L → (Mg) + Mg2Sn, lies at 563.4 °C.
The Mg–Sn system belongs to the 20 binaries of the ORCHID benchmark, chosen to cover diagram types such as congruent compound.
The thermodynamic description is the SGTE collection entry [1], which reproduces the assessment of S.G. Fries, unpublished work, 2004. [2].
The calculations use pycalphad 0.11.2 at 1 atm.
For Sn, the liquidus meets the axis at 231.9 °C.
At 563.4 °C the eutectic L → (Mg) + Mg2Sn takes place; the L phase then contains x(Sn) = 0.110.
At 204.0 °C the eutectic L → Mg2Sn + (Sn) takes place; the L phase then contains a mole fraction of 0.911.
Mg2Sn melts congruently at 775.5 °C and x(Sn) = 0.333.
The upper stability limit of Mg2Sn is 775.5 °C.
The solubility of Sn in (Mg) reaches a mole fraction of 0.031 at 563.4 °C.
At 1150 K the integral mixing enthalpy of the liquid has its minimum, −14298 J/mol, at x(Sn) = 0.380.
The calculated enthalpy of formation of Mg2Sn at 298.15 K is −25.64 kJ/mol per mole of atoms.
Its heat capacity at room temperature is 28.43 J/(mol K).
For the equiatomic liquid at 1150 K, the Gibbs energy of mixing is −18.82 kJ/mol-atom.
This document is synthetic and exists only to test extraction tools; its truth key lists every boundary, field, invariant, plotted point, table cell and stated value.
